rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the four signatures (`topology.read`, `current.book`, `gs.apply`, `solve.fixed_point`) are each one pure function hiding a substantial stage, and each stage is over different machinery with its own analytic oracle and negative control, not four wrappers over one mechanism; `topology.read` additionally absorbs the design inventory's 17 null-role and 23 region-role implementations behind the one read, which is the definition of depth.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — every proposed owner is either an existing file extended in place (`topology.py`, `constraint.py`, `polygon_moments.py`) or a named replacement of an owner being deleted in the same plan (`current.py`/`gs.py`/`solve.py` for `clip_quadrature.py`, `forward_operator.py`, `fixed_point.py`, `reduced_newton.py`), and each carry-over states the file to extend; no shared infrastructure is forked.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; the two sections that add operand vocabulary (§2 `TopologyPolicy`, §5 `SolvePolicy`) each state in their own text that the type is merged into the existing `ForwardSolvePolicy` "extended rather than duplicated", and §6 retires `SolveRoute` (six members to one), `SupportClipMode` and eight plumbing fields of `ForwardSolvePolicy`, with the before-and-after field counts stated as the interface-budget accounting the zero-count claim rests on.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan searched the codebase it names and its composed-review ledger carries eight cite-or-justify rulings (GMRES kernel, backtracking helpers, Newton candidates, operand layouts, clip helpers, polygon moments, contour tree, constraint scale, moment-map derivative); each named mechanism exists in the file cited, and the retirement census names importers (`mast_parity_chain.py`, `biot/boundary.py`, `steering_frames.py`, 177 `benchmarks/` files) that all bind the module whose deletion they are listed against.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the plan adds no thin layer: `gs.apply` "replaces the map ForwardFluxOperator performs rather than wrapping it", `current.book` replaces `clipped_support_current_moments` and the support partition, `solve.fixed_point` replaces `newton_krylov`, `picard` and `operator_request_body` in place of the file, and the retained `forward.py` is an existing request/receipt adapter that shrinks, with its retention justified by the transport-window consumer ruling rather than newly introduced.
